description: Approved production route inventory for this release branch. verify-release.js diffs the actual next export output against this list — any route that appears in one but not the other fails the gate. Update this file deliberately, in the same change that adds/removes a route, per P1-404-INCIDENT-RCA-AND-RELEASE-PROTOCOL.md §H item 1-2. As of 2026-10-18 the route surface is deliberately pruned to 3 routes via next.config.js's exportPathMap (PLAN-PRODUCTION-ROUTE-ALLOWLIST.md) — every other page stays in pages/ for code tracking but is excluded from next export's own output; adding a page to PRODUCTION_ROUTES there must be paired with adding it here in the same change, per that plan's §9 (How to add a route).
_forbiddenIdentifiers_note: Deliberately does NOT include function/hook names like useAuthoringToolsVisibility or createConfigScopeBinding — production stubs must keep those exact names for the webpack alias substitution to work at all (see next.config.js), so they always appear, harmlessly, with no-op bodies. Found the hard way: an earlier version of this list flagged them and produced false positives on every real page. Use markers that are structurally impossible for a stub to produce instead — real UI text, or a CSS-module class prefix that only exists if Panel.module.css was actually imported (stubs never import it).
